articles.title: Growing sexual assault cases in Delhi: SC draws parallel to 2012 Nirbhaya gangrape

articles.title: Video: Ujjain tensions flare after clash over part of Shahi mosque demolition
articles.summary: A large crowd clashed with police in Ujjain due to plans to demolish part of the Shahi Masjid. Stone-throwing individuals intensified the situation, prompting police to intervene and control the unrest.

articles.title: 'We have a serious problem': CJP's Abhijeet Dipke reacts to LPU unrest
articles.summary: Protests erupted at Lovely Professional University in Punjab following allegations of a rape committed on campus. Students vandalized property and clashed with police, resulting in several injuries and damaged vehicles.

articles.title: Taylor Swift remembers in her speech for the Video of the Year award
articles.summary: Taylor Swift recently won the Video of the Year award at the MTV VMAs for her song ‘Fate of Ophelia.' She accepted the award after being recognized for her work as a director and an artist. Swift dedicated her award to Dolly Parton, highlighting the impact of her songwriting and stories.

articles.title: AR Rahman, Michael Jackson planned song for Rajinikanth
articles.summary: In an intriguing twist of fate, AR Rahman and the legendary Michael Jackson had united their creative forces for a track intended for the film 'Enthiran'. Unfortunately, the song remained incomplete due to Jackson's untimely passing.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran called a 'red-headed puppet' on 'SNL UK' - WATCH

articles.title: Parineeti Chopra recalls crying throughout her first work trip
articles.summary: Parineeti Chopra expressed her feelings of overwhelming emotional pain when she left her baby for the first time. She reflected on the journey back to Bombay, which she could barely remember due to her distress.
